en: Fixed an uncaught Claude stream error when Windows temporarily blocks replacing a task record. Task saves now retry transient file locks for a bounded period and use unique temporary files.

Avoided repeated writes for unchanged Claude session IDs. Persistent stream-processing failures stop the isolated process and report an uncertain task state; failed replacements preserve the original file and a recovery copy.
zh: 修复 Windows 暂时阻止替换任务记录时，Claude 消息流触发未捕获主进程异常的问题。保存记录改用独立临时文件，并对短暂占用进行有限重试。
Claude 会话编号未变化时不再重复写盘。消息流处理持续失败时受控停止独立进程，并报告待核对状态；替换失败会保留原文件和待保存副本。
